summary: Tested Fundle Brain (iter22) end to end: 9 pytest checks with no LLM calls (sessions CRUD, 403 for a caller without the brain perm, own-sessions only, audit/requests endpoints, _scrub/$where/password guards) all pass. Ran 7 live GPT-6-Luna turns over SSE plus UI. Working: the read question (131 prospects with email, hourly cap 25); asking WHY when no reason is given (an invented reason was rejected by the guard and hourly_cap stayed 25); a real reason changed it to 40 with an audit row; the campaign queued 2 'brain' docs as approved and both were then stopped; grocery contact priority (56 brands, contacts_only not enabled); escalation (brain_requests #1 logged, email failed in preview as expected). UI: sidebar card, new chat, examples, streaming, tool chips, reload keeps history, delete and audit log all work. Several logic and security defects are listed below.

critical.issue: mailboxes.smtp_password_enc is not in SECRET, so find_records on mailboxes sent the encrypted SMTP password to the LLM (seen in the tool_done summary). update_records also lets the Brain overwrite smtp_password_enc, because _fields_ok only checks the SECRET names. Fix: add smtp_password_enc (or any key ending in _enc) to SECRET.

_scrub drops every '_id' key, and $group puts its group key in _id. So every breakdown loses its labels: the email count came back as [{count:132},{count:2090}] with no true/false key. Category or status breakdowns can't be read. Fix: keep _id in aggregate results (only remove ObjectId values), or rename _id to 'group'.

The Brain can't pin the MAIN inbox. from_inbox only accepts an email address, the main inbox address isn't in get_system_overview, and 'main' or 0 isn't accepted. Asked for 'from the main inbox', it queued with force_sender=null (rotating), then stopped its own emails. Fix: accept 'main'/0 in from_inbox and list the main inbox address/id in the overview. Also tell the model to check the inbox before queuing.

minor.issue: The default priority is 5, but contacts.next_contacts_job's priority pass matches contacts_priority == 1 exactly. Priority 5 brands skip that pass and only rank higher inside the enriched/discovered passes. Also, the $unset of contacts_status re-queues brands that already have contacts: 7 of the 56 grocery brands were 'done' with contacts and are now queued for paid re-research. Fix: use $gte 1 in the priority pass and skip brands that are done with emails unless asked.

When the email fails, the error is the raw KeyError text "'client_id'". The model then told the user 'I couldn't submit the request' although brain_requests #1 was saved. Fix: return a clear message (request logged as #N; email not sent because no inbox is connected) and tell the model.

The regex only blocks reasons starting with 'User requested/asked/wants'. The model got past it on its third try by mixing the user's reason with its own words, which was acceptable here. Older audit rows 1-2 (from E1's manual test) show invented reasons that were accepted. Expect the model to try invented reasons several times; each failed try writes an audit row.

_check only blocks $where/$function/$accumulator/$out/$merge. $lookup and $unionWith can read collections outside READ_COLS, such as sessions or tokens. Output is scrubbed only by key name. Consider blocking $lookup/$unionWith/$graphLookup when 'from' is not in READ_COLS.

This is a full replace, not a partial update: missing fields fall back to the Pydantic defaults (daily_cap 100, cc '', the default pitch). The review request suggested 'PUT settings' to restore the cap, which is a trap. I PUT only {hourly_cap:25}, which reset cc and daily_cap; I restored cc=vineet.narang@fundle.ai and daily_cap=200 straight in the DB. pitch is now DEFAULT_PITCH: if a custom pitch was saved before, it was lost and must be re-entered.

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Emailed Vineet a change request' chip is green although emailed=false. The chip only reflects ok, not the email result.
After the first message a new chat keeps showing 'New chat' until the list refreshes again or the page reloads. loadList() after setBusy is not awaited and the title can arrive late.
The delete button is invisible until hover (opacity-0), so it can't be found on touch screens, and it deletes without asking.

issues: The 11px slate-400 subtitle has low contrast on white

action_items: Add smtp_password_enc (and *_enc keys) to SECRET in core/brain.py so it is hidden from reads and blocked in update_records
Let send_email_campaign/send_single_email pin the main inbox ('main'/0) and put the main inbox address/id in get_system_overview
Fix the contacts_priority mismatch (contacts.py matches ==1, Brain default is 5) and don't re-queue brands that are already done with contacts
When the escalation email fails, return a clear message that the request was logged
Consider making PUT /api/outreach/settings merge with the saved settings instead of resetting missing fields to defaults
critical_code_review_comments: brain.py _scrub removes _id everywhere, which breaks aggregations
t_contacts $unset contacts_status re-queues brands already marked done
t_escalate KeyError text leaks to the user; the result needs a 'logged' flag
aggregate $lookup can reach collections outside READ_COLS
routes/brain._session lets admins open any user's session by id (probably intended); GET /sessions correctly lists only your own

success_rate.backend: 9/9 pytest pass; LLM flows 5/6 work as specified (main-inbox pin fails)

seed_data_creation: Brain session 4 (7 turns) and session 5 (deleted in UI). Outreach ids 787 and 788 (kind brain, status stopped). brain_audit rows 3-10, brain_requests #1 (TEST_escalation). 56 grocery prospects set to contacts_priority=1 with contacts_status unset. A TEST_brain_caller user was created and deleted.
data_changes_to_existing_data: outreach settings: hourly_cap restored to 25. My partial PUT reset cc and daily_cap (restored to vineet.narang@fundle.ai / 200) and pitch (now DEFAULT_PITCH; earlier custom value unknown). 7 grocery prospects that were 'done' with contacts are re-queued for contact search.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use brain_chat_cli.py <sid|new> 'msg' to run SSE turns. Prospecting settings already had enabled=false, phase=contacts before this run (not changed by me). No inbox is connected in preview, so sends and the escalation email fail as expected.
